tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Fresh single transparent RGBA illustration for a children’s educational video, not an edit. Image1 is exact adopted Steller sea lion identity, style and body proportion reference. Draw ONE complete resting sea-lion character at high native resolution, similar left-facing three-quarter pose, same head-to-body size, round dot eye, small ear, ochre-gold upper body and rusty-brown lower/flippers, warm brown clean outline, gentle watercolor paper texture.
ROLE species_b, second phase of a gentle front-flipper greeting: its NEAR front flipper stays resting as in reference. Its FAR front flipper is lifted only a little forward off the floor, smoothly lowering after a small wave. There are EXACTLY TWO FRONT FLIPPERS TOTAL: one near resting, one far slightly raised. Since the far flipper moved, there is NO extra far resting flipper at lower left. Count: exactly 2 front flippers plus 2 small rear flippers at the rear right. No additional fin/limb/tail. Preserve reference body mass, neck/head proportions and resting projection, all four appendages naturally attached. No humans/hands/fingers.
Generous fully transparent margins; no backdrop, ground, shadow, glow, clouds, props, effects, labels, text or border. Full crisp clean connected subject without detached fragments, smudged pigment clumps, duplicate limbs, clipping or alpha haze. Open eye must remain simple solid brown dot with no glint.
